name: org_graph_remove_level
description: Remove a level from the Org Graph's taxonomy, from effective_on (today by default). A level goes once no unit, retired units included, holds it on that date or after; reading an earlier date still shows it. The refusal names the units that hold it, or the last day one did. A level an HRIS provides is handed back to Espalia first. A level a live plan places a unit at stays until the plan changes or is archived. The organisation's structure needs a tenant admin or an Org Graph editor; a unit's own structure also admits an owner of that unit or a unit above it, and anyone above them in the reporting line.

structure_unit_id.description: a unit with a structure of its own, to change its unit types; the organisation's structure by default
